name: Atlas 300I Pro Inference Card User Guide - Specifications
notes: PRIMARY VENDOR SOURCE. Huawei enterprise documentation, freely accessible without login. Gives exact memory config: LPDDR4X, 24 GB, 384-bit, 4266 Mbit/s, 204.8 GB/s total, ECC. Also 1x '310 series Processor' with 8 Da Vinci AI cores + 8 Huawei CPU cores, 72 W board power, PCIe Gen4 x16, PCI ID 0x19E5:0xD500. Note Huawei does NOT publish an INT8/FP16 TOPS figure for the 310 series anywhere in this document - only core counts. Any TOPS number for 310P is third-party, not Huawei. | SOURCE AUDIT 2026-10-03: a plain HTTP probe from an unauthenticated datacenter IP gets HTTP 403 'Access Denied' from support.huawei.com. That is anti-bot gating, NOT evidence the document moved or is dead, so the URL is deliberately left unchanged and no archived_url was substituted. A future auditor should re-verify from a browser session rather than recording this as a dead link.
